title: Category Browse Engine (C++)
description: A C++17 batch service that ranks products for storefront category pages is returning wrong products, wrong counts and sometimes nothing. Debug it until its output matches the specification.

execution.test: mkdir -p .oa && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug > .oa/cmake.log 2>&1 || { cat .oa/cmake.log; exit 1; }; cmake --build build -j2 && python3 .oa/support/grade.py --binary build/category_engine --smoke data --suite 'sample:tests/fixtures/mini:tests/fixtures/mini/expected_results.json' --junit .oa/results.xml
execution.finalTest: rm -rf build && mkdir -p .oa && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug > .oa/cmake.log 2>&1 || { cat .oa/cmake.log; exit 1; }; cmake --build build -j2 && python3 .oa/support/grade.py --binary build/category_engine --smoke data --suite 'sample:tests/fixtures/mini:tests/fixtures/mini/expected_results.json' --suite 'hidden:data:.oa/hidden/data/expected_results.json:hidden' --junit .oa/results.xml
